leadText: Volume 16: From Dewford to Slateport is the sixteenth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second of eight volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.
plainText:
Volume 16: From Dewford to Slateport is the sixteenth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second of eight volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
Ruby and Sapphire go their separate ways to achieve their dreams in just eighty days! But their paths keep crossing... While Ruby seeks a beautiful new Pokémon in Dewford Town to help him win Pokémon Contests, he runs into Sapphire who is challenging the local Gym Leader to improve her Pokémon battle skills. Together, our intrepid Trainers attempt to deliver an important letter. What does it say, and who is the mysterious recipient...?

Plus, can Ruby and Sapphire prevent evil Team Magma from stealing a strange new technology?!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 191 - Blowing Past Nosepass II
Chapter 192 - Stick This in Your Craw, Crawdaunt I

Chapter 195 - Mashing Makuhita
Chapter 196 - Ring Ring Goes Beldum
Chapter 197 - Heavy Hitting Hariyama
Chapter 198 - Adding It Up with Plusle & Minun I
Chapter 199 - Adding It Up with Plusle & Minun II
Chapter 200 - Tripped Up by Torkoal
Chapter 201 - Slugging It Out with Slugma

==Major events==
 
leaves to Dewford Town.
wakes up on Mr. Briney's boat.
Sapphire and Ruby meet up once again at Dewford. 
Ruby meets Steven Stone.
Ruby and Sapphire reach the Abandoned Ship.
Sapphire and Ruby battle against Courtney and Tabitha.
Courtney and Tabitha get away with the Scanner.
Ruby and Sapphire go their separate ways.
Ruby lures Blaise onto the Submarine Explorer 1.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
None

===Evolutions===
Sapphire's "Chic" evolves into in PS195.
Sapphire's "Rono" evolves into in PS195.
Ruby's "Kiki" evolves into in PS196.
Ruby's "Nana" evolves into in PS196.
Ruby's "Mumu" evolves into in PS200.

==Gym battles==
defeats Roxanne in PS191.
Sapphire defeats Brawly in PS197.

==Pokémon Contests==
 doesn't participate in any Pokémon Contests.
